'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Killing of Yahya Sinwar]]
****The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] announces that [[Yahya Sinwar]], the de facto [[List of leaders of Hamas|leader]] of [[Hamas]] and the mastermind of the [[October 7 attacks]], was killed along with two other militants in a [[shootout]] with [[Israel]]i forces in [[Rafah Governorate]], [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.azernews.az/region/232711.html (AzerNews)] [https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/israel-iran-gaza-lebanon-10-17-24-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
***[[2024 Lebanon war]]
****Five [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli soldiers]] from the [[Golani Brigade]] are killed in fighting with [[Hezbollah]] forces in [[southern Lebanon]]. IDF Spokesman [[Daniel Hagari]] says several Hezbollah operatives have been captured during the clashes. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/5-soldiers-killed-several-more-hurt-amid-fighting-with-hezbollah-in-southern-lebanon/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***[[2024 missile strikes in Yemen]]
****[[U.S.]] [[Northrop B-2 Spirit|B-2 Spirit]] [[stealth bomber]]s carry out raids on underground bunkers used by the [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] in [[Sanaa Governorate]], [[Yemen]]. [[United States Secretary of Defense|U.S. Defense Secretary]] [[Lloyd Austin]] says that five underground facilities were targeted in the strikes. [https://apnews.com/article/us-airstrikes-yemen-houthi-rebels-israel-hamas-war-99721f7f952d66d6da27e24dc3c189c3 (AP)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[FARC dissidents]] open fire against a prison convoy in [[Cauca Department]], [[Colombia]], killing two prison guards and serial killer [[Manuel Octavio Bermúdez]]. Six others are wounded. [https://www.infobae.com/colombia/2024/10/18/el-monstruo-de-los-canaduzales-violador-comparado-con-garavito-murio-en-atentado-contra-patrulla-del-inpec/?outputType=amp-type (Infobae)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**A [[suicide bombing]] at a restaurant in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], kills at least seven people and injures at least six others. [[Islamic terrorism|Islamic terrorist]] group [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://al24news.com/en/somalia-seven-killed-in-suicide-attack-in-mogadishu/ (AL24 News)] [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/7-killed-6-injured-in-suicide-attack-on-cafe-in-somalia (Daily Sabah)]

'''International relations'''
*[[South Africa–Taiwan relations]]
**The [[Government of South Africa]] orders [[Taiwan]] to relocate its [[Taipei Liaison Office in South Africa|representative office]] from the South African capital of [[Pretoria]], allegedly due to pressure from [[China]]. [https://focustaiwan.tw/politics/202410170027 (Focus Taiwan)]

'''Law and crime''' 
*A court in [[Vietnam]] sentences tycoon [[Trương Mỹ Lan]] to [[life in prison]] for fraud, in addition to a [[death sentence]] that Lan received in April for embezzlement. [https://www.rfa.org/english/news/vietnam/truong-my-lan-fraud-trial-sentence-10172024060404.html (Radio Free Asia)]
*A court in [[Bangladesh]] orders the arrest of former prime minister [[Sheikh Hasina]] and 45 others for [[crimes against humanity]]. Hasina is in exile in [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/bangladesh-sheikh-hasina-arrest-warrant-isssued-f92d56b9c9930e9c6438c141c20f4b34 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[Senate of Kenya|Senate]] of [[Kenya]] convicts [[Deputy President of Kenya|Deputy President]] [[Rigathi Gachagua]] on 5 out of 11 charges, thereby removing him from office. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czrmzzkdk1do (BBC News)]
